description: Looks up up to 3 rackets by name in the Padel USA store and returns their specs (shape, balance, weight, core feel, handling, level, play style, surface), price, and product and add-to-cart links. Use it to answer questions about a specific racket or to compare 2 or 3 rackets side by side. A racket that is not returned is not currently sold in stock by Padel USA.

names.description: Racket brand and model names, e.g. ["Babolat Technical Viper 2026", "Nox AT10 Genius 18K"].
